summary: Backend-only regression test for POST /api/contracts/{id}/complete after the `accepted_by None` fix. Verified all 4 fix sites work by exercising the complete endpoint on multi-join LFG, multi-crew manifest, and single-bid-unaccepted contracts (previously returned 500 AttributeError, now 200). Also verified 401 unauthenticated and 403 unrelated-user paths. 5/5 pytest cases pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at server.py:2123, 2150, 2166, and 4252 correctly coerces `accepted_by` None -> {} using `(contract.get('accepted_by') or {}).get('id')` — clean idiomatic pattern.
Consider a shared helper `_accepted_by_id(contract)` to avoid the duplicated `(contract.get('accepted_by') or {}).get('id')` expression across 4 sites (DRY).
server.py is 5012 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; long-term refactor into routers/modules is recommended.
test_credentials: demo-login via POST /api/auth/demo-login; admin beecroft519@gmail.com (used for 403 cross-user)
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 TEST_ prefixed contracts via demo user. They are auto-cleaned by contract_expiry_loop (~1 hour).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_contract_complete.py covers the `accepted_by` None fix across LFG multi-join, multi-crew manifest, single-bid unaccepted, unauth, and unrelated-user (403). Two originally-listed scenarios (accepted mercenary completes, single-bid with accepted mercenary) were not explicitly executed because they'd require standing up a second verified merc + accept flow; however the code path they hit is unchanged by the fix and remains covered by the shared `is_merc` equality check.
rca of the issue: Original bug: `contract.get('accepted_by', {}).get('id')` crashed with AttributeError when `accepted_by` was explicitly set to None (multi-crew / multi-join / open single). dict.get returns the stored None (not the default) when the key exists with value None, so `.get('id')` on None raised. Fix: `(contract.get('accepted_by') or {}).get('id')` treats None-or-missing identically. Verified: 5/5 tests pass, poster of multi-join and multi-crew contracts now receives 200 with {message: 'Contract marked complete'}.
